description: Integrations: every system your workspace's app talks to and every call it makes, read from its code — between systems (the app ⇄ each system by business object, interfaces, cross-system flows), the integration data sheet (source → target), the endpoints, the systems, the diagrams (landscape, a system, a page), exported as a PDF or an Excel workbook (desktop/lib/integrations.js, /__pages/integrations).

m.description: The scan: { app, apps, totals, systems, rows, endpoints, flows, matrix, pages, unresolved, at, by }.

tab.description: overview | flows | pages | saved | sheet | endpoints | systems | diagrams

fObject.description: The data sheet shows one business object (an interface's objectKey) — from "Its rows" on an interface.

limit.description: How many data-sheet rows are shown (More shows the next ones).

sq.description: System flows: find an interface or a cross-system flow.

dia.description: landscape | systems | journeys | pages | system | page | pageflow

sfView.description: System flows: summary (by business object) | detailed (the flows → systems, each system's pages → endpoints).

sfSystem.description: System flows › Detailed: the system shown in detail (its first one when empty).

pgId.description: Page flows: the page shown (the first with calls when empty).

pgView.description: Page flows: flow (the page's flow in swimlanes, system by system) | one (its details: what sets each call off → its calls → the systems) | all (every page → the systems).

pdfPages.description: The PDF holds every page's integration flow (Page by page).

plain.description: Page flows in plain English (a sentence per call, what sets it off in words) — for a business reader.

flowChecks.description: Check all against the app: { flowId: { ok, text, … } } (resources/js/flowModel.js check).

saveForm.description: Save as flow: { mode page | blank, page, name, purpose, area, owner, status, story, tags }.

flowsChanged.description: A saved flow was saved or removed in another tab: the list reads them again (shellBus topic saved-flows-changed).
